data_note: Built from publisher RSS metadata (titles + teaser text). `coverage_window_hours` is the default (40h); several feeds use a longer `rollingHours` (see `scripts/build-digest.mjs`) so rows align with what is still on each publisher’s listing pages. section_overviews.commercial_observer:
Whole Foods to Open Daily Shop at Murray Hill’s 509 Third Avenue: Whole Foods Market has leased a 9,000-square-foot retail space in Manhattan’s Murray Hill neighborhood. The 15-year deal occupies a ground-floor space and outdoor terraces at 509 Third Avenue , according to a memorandum of lease filed in city records Friday morning.

Burlington Takes 44K SF at Bay Ridge Retail Center Development: Off-price retailer Burlington has inked a 44,070-square-foot retail lease at Century Marketplace , a new retail development coming to 458 86th Street in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, developer MCB Real Estate announced Tuesday.

Mac Cosmetics’ SoHo Flagship Relocates to 5K SF at 579 Broadway: Mac Cosmetics has selected a new foundation in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood. The global makeup brand signed a 5,325-square-foot lease at 579 Broadway between Prince and East Houston streets to host its next flagship location in the trendy shopping corridor, according to an announcement from landlord broker Newmark .

Retail Landlords Need to Underwrite Their Tenants’ Customer Base, Too: Landlords underwrite the retail tenant. But they almost never underwrite the tenant’s customer.
section_overviews.cre_daily:
Fields West in Frisco Hits 75% Pre-Lease With New Tenants: Fields West, a Frisco mixed-use development, has pre-leased 75% of its retail and dining space with seven new tenants. The new leases include brands like Lululemon, Boll & Branch, and Flower Child, bringing the roster to 44 retail and restaurant tenants.

July Retail Sales Dip as Online Spending Pulls Back: Marcus & Millichap Research Services reported core retail sales fell 0.2% in July but remained 4.8% above year-earlier levels. Online spending dropped 2.3%, its largest monthly decline since January 2025.

Nike Closes 15 Small Format Nike Live Retail Stores: Nike has permanently closed at least 15 Nike Live stores across 12 states, per Retail Dive. The concept launched in 2018 on Melrose Avenue with footprints planned at roughly 4K SF.

Developers Land $75M Loan for Queens Shopping Center Redo: BTF Whitestone LLC secured a $75 million loan from Acadia Realty Trust, arranged by Northmarq, to acquire and redevelop Whitestone Shopping Center in Queens. The 119,584-square-foot, Key Food-anchored center was acquired for $56 million earlier this month and includes tenants like JPMorgan Chase and Webster Bank.
section_overviews.new_york_post:
Yayoi Kusama wasn’t only displayed in museums — but also in other unexpected buildings across NYC: Yayoi Kusama’s iconic art lives on across NYC, from a colorful mosaic at Grand Central Madison to works once displayed at a luxury rental tower.

Longtime NYC staple Barzini’s to be evicted after falling over $1M behind on rent: ‘I’m in tears’: Barzini's -- plastered with liquidation signs for weeks -- will be booted from its Broadway space next week after owners ignored an initial June deadline to vacate the premises, Joseph Cervini, an attorney representing the landlord, told The Post.

How Floyd Mayweather landed a $100K/month NYC apartment in 1 day — before he allegedly stopped paying rent: Mayweather's former landlords at the Baccarat are suing him in New York State Supreme Court for breach of contract over allegations of unpaid rent.

America’s pandemic-era cash-buying boom is fading — but it’s still king for certain home sales: All-cash home sales are declining across the US in 2026, but cash still dominates luxury homes and markets like Miami.

items.headline: Whole Foods to Open Daily Shop at Murray Hill’s 509 Third Avenue
items.summary: Whole Foods Market has leased a 9,000-square-foot retail space in Manhattan’s Murray Hill neighborhood. The 15-year deal occupies a ground-floor space and outdoor terraces at 509 Third Avenue , according to a memorandum of lease filed in city records Friday morning. The 35-story, 229-unit apartment tower, known as the Murray , was developed by Kahen Properties with Lalezarian Properties . A spokesperson for Whole Foods confirmed the lease in an email to Commercial Observer, but declined to share further details.…

items.headline: Burlington Takes 44K SF at Bay Ridge Retail Center Development
items.summary: Off-price retailer Burlington has inked a 44,070-square-foot retail lease at Century Marketplace , a new retail development coming to 458 86th Street in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, developer MCB Real Estate announced Tuesday. The site between Fourth and Fifth avenues is undergoing a $130 million mixed-use redevelopment to turn the former 14-lot Century 21 department store assemblage into a 95,000-square-foot retail center.…

items.headline: Fields West in Frisco Hits 75% Pre-Lease With New Tenants
items.summary: Fields West, a Frisco mixed-use development, has pre-leased 75% of its retail and dining space with seven new tenants. The new leases include brands like Lululemon, Boll & Branch, and Flower Child, bringing the roster to 44 retail and restaurant tenants. This adds momentum to the 55-acre urban village, part of the 2,545-acre Fields master plan aiming for 11M SF of commercial and office space.…

items.headline: Mac Cosmetics’ SoHo Flagship Relocates to 5K SF at 579 Broadway
items.summary: Mac Cosmetics has selected a new foundation in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood. The global makeup brand signed a 5,325-square-foot lease at 579 Broadway between Prince and East Houston streets to host its next flagship location in the trendy shopping corridor, according to an announcement from landlord broker Newmark . The deal represents a relocation of just two blocks from Mac’s current perch alongside Bloomingdale’s at 506 Broadway .…

items.headline: Retail Landlords Need to Underwrite Their Tenants’ Customer Base, Too
items.summary: Landlords underwrite the retail tenant. But they almost never underwrite the tenant’s customer. They should. That gap costs landlords money, and it is fixable before a listing goes live. The standard leasing process is too reactive: Review comparable rents, post the space on Crexi and LoopNet, wait for responses, and then vet an operator’s finances. Mark Kvetkovskiy. None of that tells you whether enough of that retailer’s customers live near the space.…

items.headline: Planet Fitness Takes 15K SF at Coney Island Residential Development
items.summary: Wake up, it’s time for a workout. Planet Fitness has inked a 14,500-square-foot retail lease at the base of a new residential tower in Coney Island, Brooklyn, with Cammeby’s International Group and Rybak Development . Planet Fitness will move into the space at 532 Neptune Avenue next year on a 10-year lease with an asking rent of $65 per square foot, according to the New York Business Journal , which first reported the deal.…

items.headline: L3 Capital Secures 24K SF for Bylt Basics, Zara Flagships in Williamsburg
items.summary: L3 Capital ’s 108 North Sixth Street and 184-192 Bedford Avenue are welcoming two retail flagships to Williamsburg, Brooklyn. Men’s apparel brand Bylt Basics has selected 108 North Sixth Street, between Berry Street and Wythe Avenue, to host its first permanent New York City storefront, Commercial Observer has learned, in a bold signal of the retail corridor’s growing retail dominance.…

items.headline: July Retail Sales Dip as Online Spending Pulls Back
items.summary: Marcus & Millichap Research Services reported core retail sales fell 0.2% in July but remained 4.8% above year-earlier levels. Online spending dropped 2.3%, its largest monthly decline since January 2025. Seven of 10 retail categories still posted gains. Apparel sales rose 1.9%. Off-price retailers signed more than 100 leases totaling roughly 3M SF during the 12 months through July.…

items.headline: Nike Closes 15 Small Format Nike Live Retail Stores
items.summary: Nike has permanently closed at least 15 Nike Live stores across 12 states, per Retail Dive. The concept launched in 2018 on Melrose Avenue with footprints planned at roughly 4K SF. The closures land during a punishing year that included a 12-year stock low and a JPMorgan downgrade. Key Takeaways According to Bisnow, Nike is closing at least 15 stores it opened under the Nike Live banner. The format was built to serve shoppers in their own neighborhoods.…

items.headline: Developers Land $75M Loan for Queens Shopping Center Redo
items.summary: BTF Whitestone LLC secured a $75 million loan from Acadia Realty Trust, arranged by Northmarq, to acquire and redevelop Whitestone Shopping Center in Queens. The 119,584-square-foot, Key Food-anchored center was acquired for $56 million earlier this month and includes tenants like JPMorgan Chase and Webster Bank. The deal reflects strong lender appetite for grocery-anchored retail even as broader financing conditions tighten across other property types.…

items.headline: Pilates Studio Sancta Selects Tribeca’s 124 Hudson Street for First Location
items.summary: A high-end Pilates studio has found its center in Manhattan’s Tribeca neighborhood. Sancta , a studio specializing in reformer Pilates, has inked a 2,350-square-foot lease for its debut location at 124 Hudson Street , Commercial Observer has learned. The studio agreed to a seven-year term with landlord Marx Realty for the ground-floor lease, with an asking rent of $150 per square foot.…

items.headline: NYC Grocery Lawsuit Puts Subsidized Retail Space at Risk
items.summary: The Multicultural Business Coalition, representing roughly 65 grocer organizations, sued New York City over Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s plan for city-owned, subsidized municipal grocery stores. Under the proposal, the city would own five grocery locations while outside operators run them rent-free, a structure the coalition argues independent grocers cannot match.…

items.headline: Indian Restaurant Samudhra Takes 10K SF at 312 West 43rd Street
items.summary: New Jersey-based Indian restaurant Samudhra is establishing a presence across the Hudson River in Hell’s Kitchen. The eatery signed a 10,000-square-foot lease on the ground level of the Ellery at 312 West 43rd Street , owned by Taconic Partners and National Real Estate Advisors , for its second location in the U.S. following its first restaurant in Franklin Park, N.J., according to the landlords.…

items.headline: Harrison Street, Meridian Buy 431K-SF NoVA Office Portfolio
items.summary: Meridian Group and Harrison Street Asset Management have acquired a five-building office portfolio in Chantilly, Va., as part of a broader push to attract national security, defense and intelligence firms as tenants. The joint venture, which also includes HLM Associates , acquired the Stoneleigh and Newbrook campuses totaling 431,000 square feet in the Westfields submarket of Fairfax County.…

items.headline: Savills Inks 20K-SF Deal at Rudin’s 560 Lexington Avenue
items.summary: The deal-makers at Savills have struck a lease of their own. The global real estate advisory firm is expanding its New York City presence by taking 20,481 square feet for a satellite office at Rudin ’s 560 Lexington Avenue , according to a Thursday announcement by the landlord. Savills will occupy the entire third floor at the 22-story Midtown East tower for a five-year term.…

items.headline: Global Wellness Network Havas Health Expands to 254K SF at 200 Madison Avenue
items.summary: Havas Health , a global health and wellness communications network, is expanding its Midtown headquarters, Commercial Observer has learned. Havas, which creates advertising, public relations and marketing campaigns for health care brands, signed a 15-year deal to renew its existing 189,461-square-foot office at George Comfort & Sons ’ 200 Madison Avenue and tack on an additional 64,657 square feet, according to the landlord.…

items.headline: Launch Expeditionary Learning Signs 77K-SF Lease for High School in Sunset Park
items.summary: A public charter school is leasing space from an independent Catholic order to create a new high school in Sunset Park, Brooklyn. Launch Expeditionary Learning Charter School has signed a 15-year, 77,000-square-foot lease with Redemptorist Fathers of New York at 5902 Sixth Avenue , where it will begin growing its student body in fall of 2027, according to tenant broker Open Impact Real Estate .…

items.headline: Why Buc-ee’s Is Expanding South, Not the Northeast
items.summary: Buc-ee’s is concentrating growth in Southern, business-friendly, car-dependent markets, with 37 of its stores in home-state Texas. Its travel centers can span 73,000 SF with up to 120 fuel pumps. None yet operate in New York, Illinois, or New England. Studies tie chain-heavy foodscapes to rural, car-dependent, lower-income areas, aligning with the chain’s Southern site strategy.…

items.headline: Goodland Pickleball Takes 30K SF for New Indoor Clubs in Brooklyn, Queens
items.summary: Indoor pickleball club operator Goodland Pickleball has secured two new club locations in New York City, Commercial Observer has learned. The long-term leases span a total of 30,100 square feet within Class A buildings in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, and Rego Park, Queens. Goodland, which secured its first indoor New York City club in Brooklyn’s Greenpoint neighborhood in 2024, reports 11,000 visitors to date across the city.…

items.headline: Pizza Napoli to Open in 3K SF at 383 Fifth Avenue
items.summary: As one pizzeria shuts down, another is growing in its place, Commercial Observer has learned. Pizza Napoli has signed a 2,500-square-foot lease at Jonathan and Jan Soleimani ’s 383 Fifth Avenue just off East 36th Street in Midtown, where asking rent started at $25,000 per month, according to landlord broker Meridian Capital Group . The tenant signed a 15-year lease for the space, Meridian said. The site was previously the home of Famous Italian Pizza.…

items.headline: Mexican Restaurant Santo Taco Subleases Former West Village Dig Inn Space
items.summary: Santo Taco is subleasing space formerly occupied by Dig Inn in Manhattan’s West Village, Commercial Observer has learned. The Mexican food concept launched by Santiago Perez in 2025 will take over the 2,800-square-foot, street-level and below-grade space at the Robert Jaffee -owned 232 Bleecker Street at the corner of Bleecker and Carmine streets, according to ManagRE . The sublease runs until 2041.…
